caseNameFull: Moore v. Dupree and Lamar County Board of Education and Trustees v. Dupree

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. Miss. Judgment vacated and cases remanded to the District Court to clarify whether it has enjoined only §47 of the Uniform School Law, 1986 Miss. Gen. Laws, ch. 492, or whether it has also enjoined the effect of § 52 of the Act (codified as Miss. Code Ann. § 37-7-103 (1990)), insofar as § 52 implicitly repealed Miss. Code Ann. § 37-7-611 (1972).
